overview_description.description: Hootsuite offers tools to schedule posts, monitor brand mentions, and track audience sentiment across numerous social networks and review websites. Its services include real-time alerts and predictive monitoring to manage brand reputation and identify potential crises. The platform facilitates the coordination of social media workflows and provides data analytics to measure the financial impact of digital campaigns. Additionally, the company offers a solution for employee advocacy to extend the reach of organizational content.

product.name: Hootsuite Social Media Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for scheduling, publishing, monitoring, and analyzing social media posts across multiple networks from a single dashboard.

product.name: Hootsuite Social Inbox
product.description: A unified inbox that consolidates private and public messages and comments from multiple social media platforms for streamlined engagement management.

product.name: Hootsuite Social Listening
product.description: A tool for monitoring brand mentions, keywords, and trending topics across social media to gather insights and track audience sentiment.

product.name: Hootsuite Analytics and Reporting
product.description: A feature set for tracking social media performance metrics, generating custom reports, benchmarking against competitors, and scheduling report exports.

product.name: Hootsuite AI Content Tools
product.description: AI-powered features for generating social media captions, hashtags, content ideas, and trend-based post drafts to assist content creation.

product.description: An AI agent that converts live social signals into contextual intelligence and coordinated actions for organizations.
